EmailTemplate.subject: Real Estate Investing in 2020
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},
I hope you had a great Holiday Season and end to 2019! You had previously expressed interest in Memphis Invest and I was just curious if you are still looking into turnkey real-estate investments. We are gearing up for a big 2020, and we want you involved.
Now is a perfect time to invest. We have re-branded as REI Nation to reflect our growing company. We are in 7 markets and last year each one appreciated between 4-8+% with positive cash flow. Interest rates are still down and this year we are adding 100 houses a month to our inventory, so I know we’ll be able to find something that fits your portfolio.
Please let me know if you are still interested in building out a portfolio with us, and I hope to hear from you soon.
Ben Riley
Ben Riley Portfolio Advisor REI Nation 215 360 9303 benriley@reination.com www.reination.com 1900 Exeter Rd, Suite 210, Germantown, TN 38138
